# Set the outgoing protocol at each account-configuration source

The outgoing AccountConfig template changed from an implicit type of smtp to null. The XML provider parser, guessed configuration, classic manual setup, and Account Hub manual setup each set outgoing.type="smtp" when they actually produce SMTP settings. That distinguishes an unset protocol from a known SMTP choice and allows future send protocols. CreateInBackend uses config.outgoing.type when comparing an existing server. When adding a configuration source, set the protocol where it becomes known and test that path rather than relying on a global SMTP default.

Scope: Account creation.

Paths:

- `mail/components/accountcreation/modules/AccountConfig.sys.mjs`
